special_sessions.label: Diwali Muhurat Trading session (Diwali Laxmi Pujan)
special_sessions.notes: Normal market (continuous trading) opens 14:20 and closes 15:30 for non-CAS securities; for Closing Auction Session (CAS) securities continuous trading ends 15:15 and the CAS runs 15:20-15:35. Pre-open order entry 14:05-14:15 (random closure in the last 2 minutes), matching 14:15-14:17, buffer 14:17-14:20. Block deal window 13:50-14:05. Circular: 'All trades executed in this Diwali Muhurat trading session shall result in settlement obligations.' NSE Clearing (NCL/CMPT/77037) settles them on Monday 2026-11-09.

notes: Holidays falling on a Saturday or Sunday are kept as published (2026-02-15, 2026-03-21, 2026-08-15, 2026-11-08); they do not change business-day arithmetic.
Sunday 2026-11-08 is a holiday with an explicit Muhurat special session: is_business_day() is False and is_trading_day() is True. It is never an ordinary trading day.

This is the trading calendar. Settlement dates for NSE trades are counted on the NSE Clearing calendar NCL-CM, which has extra bank-holiday closures (e.g. 2026-02-19, 2026-03-19, 2026-04-01, 2026-08-26).
NSE's terms of use prohibit systematic automated collection from its website; refresh this file by a manual, owner-approved retrieval, not a scheduled scraper.

The market-timings page lists Normal market 09:15-15:30, while the Muhurat circular also describes a Closing Auction Session for CAS securities; whether CAS applies to regular sessions for a given security is not encoded here.
